title: HSK2 Gate 7 · Eastern Han
explanationEn: Gate 7: Eastern Han. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第7关：东汉。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 很久以前，人们不在纸上写字，因为那时候还没有纸。他们把字写在竹子上面。一本书要用很多很多竹子。所以书又重又大，一个人拿不动。
passageEn: Long ago people did not write on paper, because there was none. They wrote on strips of bamboo. One book took a great deal of bamboo. So a book was heavy and bulky, and one person could not carry it.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Long ago people did not write on paper, because there was none.
comprehension.answer: 很久以前，人们不在纸上写字，因为那时候还没有纸。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: One book took a great deal of bamboo.
comprehension.answer: 一本书要用很多很多竹子。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 久 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“久”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 久 (jiǔ) means "long time" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “久”（jiǔ）的意思是“long time”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 以前 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“以前”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 以前 (yǐ qián) means "before" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “以前”（yǐ qián）的意思是“before”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 很久以前，人们不在纸上写字，因为那时候还没有纸。

options.text: Very long ago, it rained in China for many days.
Because there was so much rain, the water rose higher and higher.
The water came into the fields, and into many people’s homes.
Long ago people did not write on paper, because there was none.

check.explanationEn: "很久以前，人们不在纸上写字，因为那时候还没有纸。" means "Long ago people did not write on paper, because there was none.".
check.explanation: “很久以前，人们不在纸上写字，因为那时候还没有纸。”的意思是“Long ago people did not write on paper, because there was none.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Eastern Han in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说东汉。
